result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured aspect names, so renaming `buildAndDeployment` no longer drops it or `git-history.zip`. It compiles; I didn't run any tests or try a renamed config, so the fix is untested.

In `DataExporter.java`, the five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` literals are gone. A new private helper, `aspectFileListZipEntry(aspect)`, builds each zip entry. It gets the name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same call that names the loose text files. It then reads that file from the text folder.

With the default config the entries and their order are unchanged. With the renamed aspect, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`, and `git-history.zip` is written whenever a `git-history.txt` exists.
